scope: Images support visual inspection only. No image-based similarity, new score, humidity or soil-moisture estimate is derived from them.
earth: The three existing B17 Earth review thumbnails and exact cell IDs are documented in ../provenance.json. A photograph is never assigned to an unrelated selected cell.
moon: Connecting Ridge uses the existing PGDA 78 DEM hillshade documented in ../provenance.json. It is not a photograph or actual lunar illumination.

mars.source: NASA MRO CTX / Caltech global mosaic beta01 / Mars Trek-OnMars
mars.presentation: Original image pixels copied unchanged. Black mosaic gaps retained. CTX morphology does not measure mineral assemblages.

numeric_data: data/candidates.geojson descriptors, exact lens and target binding; no regional average or nearest-neighbour substitution.
environment: data/ledger.json; planetary or literature reference values explicitly separated from local footprint measurements.
missing_measurements: Humidity, soil moisture, local temperature and soil bearing strength are not reported as matched local values. X1 P/PET is labelled aridity, not humidity.
display_math: Numeric bars share min(0, Earth, target)..max(0, Earth, target) within each row. Delta = Earth minus target in the descriptor's raw unit. Missing and non-finite values stay unavailable; no bars or deltas are imputed.
